title: Seeing a millstone at work
passage: Welcome to the old mill. Those two large stones by the window used to sit one above the other. The upper one turned; the lower one stayed still. If you look at their flat faces, you’ll see the grooves that carried the ground grain outward. You can turn the handle on the small model near the door. We won’t be making lunch with it, though. It’s just there to show how the top stone moves, so please don’t put any grain into it. When you’ve had a turn, look in the wooden tray next to the model. There’s a stone in it with a worn edge. That one gives you an idea of what happens to the grooves after years of use.
passageZh: 歡迎來到這座老磨坊。窗邊那兩塊大磨石以前是一上一下疊放的。上面的會轉，下面的固定不動。看看它們平坦的那一面，可以看到把磨碎的穀物往外帶的溝槽。 靠門那個小模型的把手可以轉。不過可別指望用它做午餐。它只是讓大家看看上磨石怎麼轉動，請不要放穀物進去。 轉過模型後，可以看看旁邊的木托盤。裡面有一塊邊緣磨損的石頭，可以讓你了解溝槽用久了會變成什麼樣。
